Victoria Hutter from the NEA is writing to Adam Andrzejewski to dispute a claim in his recent Forbes article. She contends that, contrary to his statement that the NEA didn't disclose its grants to NYSF, the NEA has been open about its funding of the Public Theater and has shared that information freely with reporters, providing several published articles as evidence. She clarifies that while the NEA gave the Public Theater's Shakespeare in the Park festival $300,000–$320,000 over the past four years, no NEA funding went to the specific "Julius Caesar" production in question.

The NEA declined to comment on whether the Public Theater applied for grants for the summer season. The Public Theater received $25,000 for the New York Voices program at Joe's Pub. Recipients are invited to use the NEA grant search utility at https://apps.nea.gov/grantsearch/ to research any NEA grantee's funding history for the past 19 years; years prior to 1998 are available through the online archive of annual reports.
